items.q: What does the price include?
items.a: Fees, VAT, official taxes, bank coordination and integrated advisory.

items.q: What is NOT included?
items.a: Flights, accommodation, apostilles in country of origin, personal expenses.

items.q: How is payment made?
items.a: Upfront by wire transfer. No additional fees.

items.q: Can I switch programs after starting?
items.a: Yes. If mid-process you decide to upgrade (e.g. from Base to Business) we roll the paid amount into the new program and invoice the delta. No double fees.

items.q: Do I need to be in Paraguay to start?
items.a: No. We handle document pre-validation remotely. You only travel for the single operational day (migration + cédula + bank, all coordinated).

items.q: How long does the whole process take end-to-end?
items.a: 8–12 weeks typical. 6 weeks document prep + 1 trip + 2–4 weeks for residency approval + cédula issuance.

items.q: What happens if my residency is rejected?
items.a: Rejections are rare with proper document prep. If it happens for a reason within our scope (e.g. missed requirement) we re-present at our cost.

items.q: Is the 10% territorial tax guaranteed?
items.a: The 10% IRE rate is current Paraguayan law (Ley 6380). We keep you updated on any reforms and structure your setup to stay compliant under the rules that apply at the time.

pillars.description: 4.2% GDP growth in 2023. 10% IRE corporate tax. 2.1% inflation. Territorial system — foreign income not taxed locally.

pillars.title: Investment opportunities
pillars.description: No capital controls. FDI open to all sectors. Real estate in premium Asunción zones up ~30% in 5 years.

pillars.title: Quality of life
pillars.description: 30–50% lower cost of living than Berlin or Madrid. USD 4,000/month covers family, private school, and help at home.

pillars.title: Tax stability
pillars.description: 10% IRE since 2020 (Ley 6380). Territorial system stable across political cycles. Double-tax treaties with Spain, Chile, Taiwan.

pillars.title: Growth trajectory

pillars.title: Agribusiness powerhouse

pillars.title: International community
pillars.description: Established German, Spanish, Italian and Dutch communities. 5,000+ Europeans relocated in the past decade.

pillars.title: Nature and green space
pillars.description: 25M hectares of Chaco wilderness. 5 national parks within 200km of Asunción. Low population density outside the capital.

pillars.title: Culture and daily life
pillars.description: Bilingual Spanish + Guaraní culture. Homicide rate materially lower than Buenos Aires or São Paulo.

seo.description: Answers to our 15 most common questions about process, pricing and programs.

hero.headline: Frequently asked questions
hero.subheadline: The answers our clients ask about most often.

items.q: How long does the whole process take?
items.a: In-person in one day. Issuance: 45–60 days. Company + bank: 2–4 weeks. Total: 8–12 weeks.

items.q: How many trips do I need?
items.a: One trip is sufficient.

items.q: What does the price include?
items.a: Professional fees, VAT, official taxes, bank coordination, real-estate tour and integrated advisory. No additional fees.

items.q: What is NOT included?
items.a: International flights, accommodation, personal expenses, sworn translations and apostilles in your country of origin.

items.q: Do I need to speak Spanish?
items.a: No. Our team accompanies you and communicates in Dutch, English and German.

items.q: Can a foreigner open a bank account?
items.a: Yes. It is the most complex step; we prepare your financial profile and coordinate directly with the bank.

items.q: What type of company is incorporated?
items.a: Our legal team recommends the most suitable structure (typically EAS or SA).

items.q: Is the process 100% legal?
items.a: Absolutely. Strict adherence to Paraguayan and international regulations.

items.q: What if a document is missing?
items.a: We detect it before your trip. Our pre-validation ensures you arrive fully prepared.

items.q: Do you guarantee bank approval?
items.a: The decision is the bank's. We guarantee professional preparation and institutional coordination.

items.q: Can I bring my family?
items.a: Yes. Each family member requires their own residency process.

items.q: How is payment made?
items.a: Upfront by bank transfer. No additional fees.

items.q: Can I get only the residency?
items.a: Programs are integrated by design. Contact us for your specific case.

items.q: What happens after year one (Investor)?
items.a: We present a continuation proposal tailored to your needs.

items.q: What if laws change during my process?
items.a: We monitor the regulatory environment and inform you immediately of any relevant changes.

seo.title: Glossary — Nexa Paraguay
seo.description: Key terms: permanent residency, cédula, RUC, IRE, territoriality, SEPRELAD, KYC.

hero.headline: Glossary of key terms
hero.subheadline: Clear definitions of terms you'll encounter during the process.

items.q: Permanent residency
items.a: Permanent migratory status in Paraguay. Obtained through an 8–12 week process from a complete file submission.

items.q: Cédula de Identidad
items.a: Paraguayan ID card issued after residency is granted. Official document for in-country operations.

items.q: RUC
items.a: Unique Taxpayer Registry. Tax identifier equivalent to a NIF or BTW number.

items.q: 10 % IRE
items.a: Corporate income tax. General rate on income generated in Paraguay.

items.q: Territoriality
items.a: Tax system taxing only income generated within the country. Foreign income pays no IRE.

items.q: SEPRELAD
items.a: Paraguay's anti-money-laundering authority. Nexa is a reporting entity, which means strict KYC.

items.q: KYC
items.a: Know Your Customer. Identity and source-of-funds verification required to operate legally.

items.q: How does Paraguay interact with box 3?
items.a: Once you emigrate and cut ties (woonplaatsverklaring uit Nederland), box 3 no longer applies. We coordinate the timing so you do not double-book a tax year.

items.q: What about the emigratieheffing on a Dutch BV?
items.a: The exit tax on substantial interest (aanmerkelijk belang) can be deferred under the right structure. We work with Dutch tax counsel in parallel — we do not replace them.

items.q: Does Paraguay have a DTA with the Netherlands or Belgium?
items.a: No bilateral DTA as of 2026, but Paraguay's territorial system means most practical scenarios do not need one. We structure around the reality.

items.q: Can I keep my BV / BVBA after emigrating?
items.a: Yes, common arrangement — Paraguay residency + retained EU holding for specific business lines. We map the setup so both sides work.
